nodes.title: SG-10.1 Keyboard handling in the Phaser scene with typed events
nodes.body:
Context: SceneObject already has focus(), blur() and handleKey(), and buildScene.ts exports moveFocus(), but BootScene never listens to the keyboard. Desired behavior: Tab and arrow keys move focus between visible interactive objects, Enter or Space selects the focused object and opens its action menu, and Escape closes the menu. All of it is emitted as typed events on the Phaser to React bus. Why: interactive objects must be keyboard-accessible.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene with visible objects, when Tab or ArrowRight/ArrowDown is pressed, then focus moves forward and a typed focusChange event is emitted with the focused object id.
- Given a focused object, when Enter or Space is pressed, then objectClick is emitted with that object id and the ActionMenu opens.
- Given an open ActionMenu, when Escape is pressed, then a typed menuClose event is emitted and the menu closes.
- Each key has a mocked unit test, and Phaser is mocked.


## Scope
- In scope: PhaserToReactEvents additions
- In scope: BootScene keyboard listener and cleanup
- In scope: App subscription to menuClose
- Out of scope: Backend or Go API changes
- Out of scope: New visual styling
- Out of scope: Changes to the SceneObject or moveFocus logic
- Preserve: Existing objectClick and objectHover behavior
- Preserve: Pointer interaction
- Preserve: Single Phaser instance lifecycle


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Events go through game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
- Reuse moveFocus and SceneObject.handleKey


## Definition of done
- All three requirements are implemented and verified by unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- Listeners are removed on scene shutdown


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Typed focusChange and menuClose events exist on the Phaser to React bus
nodes.body:
Context: events.ts declares objectHover, objectClick, characterClick and sceneReady. Keyboard handling needs two more typed events. Desired: focusChange carries the focused object id or null, and menuClose carries no data. Why: typed events are required between Phaser and React.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the bus, when focusChange is emitted with {id:'bookshelf'}, then a subscribed handler receives that payload.
- Given the bus, when menuClose is emitted, then a subscribed handler is called once.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene changes
- Preserve: Existing event names and payloads


## Technical constraints
- Keep the dependency-free createEventBus


## Definition of done
- Interface compiles with tsc and the events are usable by emit/on


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene maps Tab, arrows, Enter, Space and Escape to focus, select and close events
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create builds SceneObjects but registers no keyboard listener. Desired: a keydown listener where Tab/ArrowRight/ArrowDown call moveFocus(+1), Shift+Tab/ArrowLeft/ArrowUp call moveFocus(-1) and emit focusChange, Enter/Space call handleKey on the focused object (which emits objectClick), and Escape emits menuClose. The listener is removed on shutdown.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given two visible objects, when Tab is pressed, then the first gets focus and focusChange is emitted with its id.
- Given a focused object, when Enter or Space is pressed, then objectClick is emitted with its id.
- Given any state, when Escape is pressed, then menuClose is emitted.
- Given scene shutdown, then the keydown listener is removed.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: SceneObject internals
- Out of scope: App
- Preserve: Existing create, sync and shutdown behavior


## Technical constraints
- Use this.input.keyboard?.on('keydown') from Phaser 3.90
- Call preventDefault on Tab


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- All five keys behave as specified


## Non-functional requirements
- No listener leak


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · App closes the ActionMenu on menuClose and keeps it open on selection
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx stores selectedId and sets it on objectClick (L58). Desired: a menuClose event clears selectedId so the ActionMenu unmounts, and the subscription is released on unmount.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a selected object with the ActionMenu shown, when menuClose is emitted, then the ActionMenu is removed.
- Given unmount, then the menuClose handler is unsubscribed.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/App.tsx
- Out of scope: ActionMenu component
- Preserve: objectClick subscription


## Technical constraints
- Use useEffect returning the unsubscribe from phaserToReact.on


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Menu closes on Escape event


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Add keyboard handler to BootScene.create and release it on shutdown
nodes.body:
Add a private onKeyDown method and register it in create, unregister in the SHUTDOWN handler.

## Acceptance criteria
- Navigation keys call moveFocus and emit focusChange.
- Enter/Space call handleKey on the focused object.
- Escape emits menuClose.
- The listener is off()'d on shutdown.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: Tests
- Preserve: Pointer click emission


## Technical constraints
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts`


## Definition of done
- BootScene handles the five key groups


## Clarifying questions
- None
nodes.summary: Wire keys to moveFocus, handleKey and events
nodes.description: Add a private onKeyDown method and register it in create, unregister in the SHUTDOWN handler.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation keys call moveFocus and emit focusChange.

Escape emits menuClose.
The listener is off()'d on shutdown.
definition_of_done: BootScene handles the five key groups

steps.action: Change the buildScene import to also import moveFocus.

Add a private arrow property onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent): void that: for 'Tab' (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1), 'ArrowRight'/'ArrowDown' (+1), 'ArrowLeft'/'ArrowUp' (-1) calls e.preventDefault(), moveFocus(this.sceneObjects, delta) and emits focusChange with the id of the object whose isFocused is true (or null); for 'Enter' or ' ' calls handleKey(e.key) on every object in sceneObjects; for 'Escape' emits menuClose with {}.
steps.expected: Method compiles with delta typed as 1 | -1 | 0 narrowed before moveFocus (cast delta as 1 | -1).

steps.action: After the characterSprites assignment add this.input.keyboard?.on('keydown', this.onKeyDown); inside the SHUTDOWN handler add this.input.keyboard?.off('keydown', this.onKeyDown) before this.unsubscribe?.().
steps.expected: Listener registered on create and removed on shutdown.
